final_message:
All 10 tests pass. TypeScript isn't available via npm, but since `node --test` ran the `.ts` files directly under type-stripping, I'll verify the syntax compiles cleanly with `npx tsc` unavailable — checking if a local tsc exists.
Implemented `TtlCache` in `src/cache.ts`. All 10 tests pass via `npm test`.

Behavior notes:
- Validity follows the tests' boundary (entry stored at time `t` with ttl `d` is served at `t + d` and expires when `now > t + d`), per `tests/cache.test.ts:34`.
- `ttlMs`/`maxEntries` validated with `RangeError`; `now` defaults to `Date.now`.
- `set` restarts lifetime; `size`/`keys`/`get`/`has`/`delete` only consider live entries; expired entries are dropped lazily on access and by `prune`/eviction.
- Eviction drops expired entries before kicking the oldest (insertion-order) live entry when over `maxEntries`.
